purpose: Prepare a separate reviewable follow-up cohort for the normal Root → Agentd → Core/Session joint Notes+Calculator entry, without changing the in-flight P0 repair candidate.

source_baseline_a69.limitation: Verified exact source-tree relationships only. No independent claim about later formatting trees, new published heads or runtime qualification is inferred.

findings.claim_zh: 当前 Desktop c42 普通 Root 启动仍专用 Notes：profile=notes、NotesStartupReservation、NotesThreadSeedReceipt、organ.desktop.notes 和 with_notes_startup_from_session_before。旧 c2 的 services 完全同树，因此也没有可直接搬来的联合普通 producer。
c42 与旧 c2 分叉，并非包含旧联合能力的后继并集。完整 UI 树和实际 parser 证明当前 c42 缺联合 Desktop/Calculator consumer 模块及 --desktop-root-bootstrap-stdin 入口。
ff72/a69 Agentd 普通 main 没有 donor 的 AgentdProductionStartup、Root preflight、sealed handoff 或联合 profile 解析；当前包不能因另一个 repo 仍 pin A39 而被视为已有这些能力。
当前泛型 AgentdProductionHostAttachment<C> 返回原 original_sender/checkpoint 绑定，且现有 desktop_objective_ui 真正依赖它。donor 同名 attach 返回 Option<NotesTargetIdentity>；整文件覆盖会回退已存在合同。
当前普通 App Server UDS 在所有连接升级前执行 current-user peer gate；donor 仅 inherited 路径允许 owner 或 Root。只能添加显式 inherited 入口，不能覆盖当前普通 peer 检查；当前 owner_local/Windows 源码也不得因 donor 没有而删除。
#4800 的 10 文件 native G2 role sockets 可提供 configure-before-publish、held-directory、NOREPLACE 和 inode-cleanup 组件；其 Root 是 PID-1 native G2 owner/control 场景，不是普通 Desktop product_root 的联合 UI producer。
donor joint profile 是新线程/新六工具目录的有限会话；仍有 300,000ms Root 上限，不含 issuer renewal/epoch continuation，不接受 previous_recovery。旧 Notes recover 不能改名当联合恢复。
ff72 与 14e2 的 compare 结果分叉且文件列表截到 300；它不是两个完整树的净差。Agentd 完整子树实际有 813 个 blob path 差异，含大量历史资格文档；本表 102 条决策记录也不是编译后证明的最小迁移文件集。不能拿旧 PR 的 89 路径代替全部先决闭包。

atomic_cohorts.title_zh: 真实 Root bootstrap 与生命周期
atomic_cohorts.minimum_contract: Root creates the actual unnamed channel before spawn; independently sealed bootstrap + same actual Root pidfd/credentials; distinct read-only deployment FD; fixed deadline, close all invalid/truncated rights.
forbidden_shortcuts: Treat FD numbers or CLI JSON as authority

atomic_cohorts.title_zh: Registry、身份转换与原 Core 入口
atomic_cohorts.minimum_contract: Preserve current Starting generation, canonical registry paths and original writer inode; single-thread authenticated preflight precedes helper alias/dotenv/runtime creation; original Core/App Server owns actual session.
must_land_together: Cargo/Bazel dependency closure and exact helper packaging
preserve: All current local peer gates and Windows source

atomic_cohorts.title_zh: 受保护 Current 与同一 writer/checkpoint
atomic_cohorts.minimum_contract: Independent authenticated Current receipt and exact writer binding enter exclusive recovery; same protected checkpoint coordinates recovered store and original Objective sender; install only after all live checks.
must_land_together: Memory transport/wire/coordinator and original store integration
preserve: No duplicate writer or manufactured Current

atomic_cohorts.title_zh: 独立 issuer、签名与单次 effect 进入
atomic_cohorts.minimum_contract: Use the same real Root issuer/frontier/clock and verified process lifetime for signed objective and FinalUse. UI receives a pre-signed capability; it cannot mint it.
must_land_together: Root issuer client/server and protected provider lifetime
preserve: Original strict no-replay and unknown semantics

atomic_cohorts.title_zh: listener 发布与 owner 保管
atomic_cohorts.minimum_contract: Keep Root-controlled ancestors, exact UID/GID/mode and retained directory/FD; only final owner listen where SO_PEERCRED requires it; configure-before-publication for native role endpoints; matching-inode cleanup.
must_land_together: Root-bound socket and inherited listener APIs
Normal versus explicit inherited peer policy
atomic_cohorts.optional_donor: #4800 native role socket component requires its own exact-source review; it does not provide normal Desktop caller wiring.

atomic_cohorts.title_zh: 普通 Root → Agentd → Core/Session 联合产品入口
atomic_cohorts.minimum_contract: A real normal producer must prepare actual Notes+Calculator Session reservation, new six-tool original Core seed, strict joint profile and policy; activate through the same Root/writer and ordered two-target offers, then retain actual UI owner.
must_land_together: New Desktop product_root producer rather than an API-only export
Reconcile c2 joint consumer modules into current c42 without overwriting native G2 work
Hepta joint Objective/Calculator types and same-writer fence
Paired exact Hepta/Desktop pins and generated lock closure
Normal entry same-tree positive and negative qualification
preserve: Old Notes initialize/recover and historical thread catalogs
Existing ff72 generic Objective UI API
No fabricated joint recovery or issuer renewal

missing_types_and_callers.current: Absent from inspected current paths; ordinary main still uses from_process_environment then run.
Donor types are absent from complete current Memory tree/export surface; current ObjectiveSenderCheckpoint abstraction exists and must remain supported.
Donor Root export surface absent in current contracts/Agentd; cannot be supplied by installing Desktop binary with unrelated A39 pin.
Add explicitly; preserve current ordinary current-user admission and owner_local types.
Donor components exist; current ordinary Hepta and Desktop producer do not compose them.
Both c42 and old c2 services still use Notes counterparts. New implementation work is required.

required: Calculator organ and its retained lifetime
missing_types_and_callers.current: Present in c2 source; absent from current c42 named modules/parser. Need source reconciliation, not whole branch adoption.

minimum_first_independent_batch.classification: A narrow dependency foundation within C2; not completion of the six-cohort B16 product entry.
minimum_first_independent_batch.scope: Add synchronous preflight API after helper dispatch and before dotenv/alias setup or runtime threads. Keep arg0_dispatch_or_else as a compatibility wrapper returning Ok(main_fn); preserve existing helper handling, package paths and guard lifetime. Do not change Agentd main or perform any credential transition in this batch.
minimum_first_independent_batch.dependencies: No new dependency or new privileged capability required by this API split. Verify generated build/lock gates if actual implementation changes declared inputs.
meaningful_additional_controls: Own a child process and prove a refused preflight exits before aliases/dotenv/runtime/main side effects; preserve the original error, rather than testing a duplicate helper implementation.
Own a child process and prove successful preflight runs on the original calling thread before the async entry/runtime starts, while helper aliases remain alive through async return.
Invoke an actual supported helper alias through the existing dispatcher and prove it dispatches before preflight; do not add fake helper shortcuts or global env races.

verification.command_status: Derived from actual codex-arg0 package declaration and the repository's existing just test recipe; not quoted as a historical run or a command already executed.

minimum_first_independent_batch.exit: Reviewed exact source diff plus original seven tests and meaningful new ordering/failure controls on the actual changed source. No normal Root acceptance or B16 closure is implied.
minimum_first_independent_batch.caller_precondition: Run the full entry on the original single-threaded process startup path. The supplied synchronous preflight must not create threads or start an asynchronous runtime; subsequent original dotenv/PATH environment mutation retains that precondition.
